acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Trolls family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Scrag, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Open-Wound Rebounder (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Gangly, warty, and mud-caked with a small head, long bare arms, scavenged rags, and several half-healing gashes that never all close at once.

Signature mechanic: Bad Closure: after a committed swipe, one half-healing gash contracts into a pale bud that will restore the arm's next attack and seal some damage; interruption at the bud stops the closure and makes the arm hang slack for one cycle.
battlefieldDuty: Probe close space with long-arm swipes while one visibly open gash cycles between collapse and rapid regrowth, creating a simple interrupt-or-withdraw decision.
constructionDimensions: Regrowth incorporates cauterized construction: charcoal callus, heat-blistered hide, iron weapons welded into scar beds, ash-packed wounds, and cracked ceramic salve pots remain layered over living Troll anatomy.

Healing motion becomes a heat cycle through curling smoke, shrinking black scar plates, red tissue visible only beneath opening cautery seams, and steam when bog moisture reaches the hot regrowth core.
counterplay: Step outside the preceding swipe, then strike the pale bud before the gash seals; missing that window lets the Scrag rebound immediately with the restored arm. Affinity signal: A cautery seam cracks and vents before tissue regrows; cooling or striking the exposed wet rim stalls the cycle before the black plate closes again.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only fire treatment without cauterized tissue, welded debris, and heat-cycle behavior
Glow-only fire treatment without a visible wound core or changing scar construction
Pure flame anatomy that removes rubbery flesh and mishealed body parts
Uniform char that conceals which wound is active
identityInvariants: Tall, stooped, potbellied humanoid silhouette with a small head on a thick neck and disproportionately long arms hanging past the knees.
Bog green, liver-brown, sallow grey, bruise purple, and wet glistening highlights keep living hide distinct from mud and scavenged rags.
Rubbery skin, scar tissue, bark-hard callus, mud, rope, and half-swallowed equipment remain visibly bodily rather than worn as deliberate finery.
Healed-over piercings, embedded bones, lodged weapons, misplaced limbs, stray jaws, and layered scars record prior injury as readable construction history.
Escalation adds accumulated misregrowth rather than simple size: open gashes become knots, alternate organs, defensive scar architecture, and finally a walking archive of incompatible healing.
telegraph: The mud-caked Scrag hunches over one always-open gash, whose rim pales and draws inward while the long attacking hand goes limp.
